project.name: OpenZaps
project.description: OpenZaps turns supported DeFi workflows into sealed, owner-signed policy capsules. Read-only agent tools may discover and simulate them; an eligible executor may submit only the signed action. No agent receives wallet keys, signing authority, arbitrary calldata, or an automatic revoke right.

disclosures.category: ERC-20 used across bounded buy, sell, stitched-route, Zap-creation fee, and automation-pot flows on Robinhood Chain
disclosures.notice: Verify the Robinhood Chain contract before signing. Market data changes over time.

appUtilities.description: App-level conveniences unlocked by connected-wallet balance in the 0xzaps.com console; not protocol rights and subject to change.
utilities: extended saved-zap history (50 slots; 100 at operator tier)
